ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across approximately 90% of the visible surface with a saturated low-intensity (black) perimeter along the trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast continuous black banding along the entire trailing edge and distal tips. Presence of at least five discrete, low-intensity circular focal points distributed across the central high-intensity region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an acute pixel angle and high-depth penetration relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations with sharp, triangular peaks and varying valley depths along the boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve sweeping upward to sharply tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density, irregular clusters of light and dark pixels indicating colonization/scarring at the far lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 4-5 parallel, unaligned low-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks) on the lower-left quadrant of the visible ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive focal bio-fouling/scarring on distal tips and prominent linear rake marks on the lower left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique punctate pigmentation pattern consisting of multiple isolated dark circular markers across the white field.
